pages.text: Small scripts by mantikafasi, short enough to type in. Labels are the names after $(5)FROM$() and $(5)TO$().
$(l)Keep one of each$()$(br)Empties a chest but leaves 1 of each item type.$(br2)$(5)every 20 ticks do$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT retain 1 each * from source$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT to out$()$(br)$(5)end$()

$(l)Recursive crafter$()$(br)Sends results back into the crafter, with the rest going to an interface.$(br2)$(5)every 20 ticks do$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT from crafter$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT to crafter$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT to interface$()$(br)$(5)end$()
$(l)Fluids to interface$()$(br2)$(5)every 20 ticks do$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT fluid:: from out$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT fluid:: to interface$()$(br)$(5)end$()

$(l)Alveary frames$()$(br)Keeps frames in a frame holder.$(br2)$(5)every 100 ticks do$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT careerbees:pheremone_frame from interface$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT to frame_holder$()$(br)$(5)end$()

$(l)Base ingots to interface$()$(br2)$(5)every 20 ticks do$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT WITH TAG #ingot*Base FROM drawer_controller$()$(br)$(5)    INPUT contenttweaker:* from drawer_controller$()$(br)$(5)    OUTPUT to interface$()$(br)$(5)end$()
